# A test reads the props of the component it takes, which is rendered with no
# call site: each holds its default, on every target, as the interpreter's
# mount binds it.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component counter(inc int = 2, label string = "n", start int) ui.node {
    var hits = inc
    ui.text(value="{label} {hits}")
    ui.button #b(text="go", @click {
        hits += inc
    })
}

func testReadsProps(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.inc == 2)
    t.assert(c.label == "n")
    t.assert(c.start == 0)
    c.b.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 4)
}

ui.window {
    counter(inc=3, start=1)
}
